recentItems.title: DISTANT - Into Despair (OFFICIAL VIDEO)
recentItems.description:
DISTANT - Into Despair (OFFICIAL VIDEO)  
New single “Into Despair” by DISTANT, out now via Century Media Records. Taken from the album “Into Despair” out November 6th, 2026. Order now: https://DistantBand.lnk.to/IntoDespair_AlbumID 
 
Director: Jachym Belcher 
Edit: Klara Galle  
Drum rental: Patrik Šedo 
  
Produced: Nouri Yetgin   
Vocals Produced: Alan Grnja, Vojta Pacesny   
Lyrics: Alan Grnja   
Mix & Master: Nouri Yetgin, Roelof Klop  
  
Lyrics: 
Into Despair  
  
Not a single day with no chance of running along with my feelings  
With everything in a single parallel  
I’m better of alone in my own head  
What do I try to achieve here  
Why do I try to please everyone  
  
Now it’s not a time to be answered  
Everything that I knew would be all washed away  
  
Bleed, Bleed, Bleed, Bleed, Bleed, Bleed, Bleed  
Slit my wrist and let me bleed  
  
Let me open my veins and let all of my feelings to flow out now  
All problems that I accumulated are still burden of my own  
  
Just sit back and watch me bleed  
Just sit back and watch me bleed  
  
In the end I don’t care to die, yeah  
Made a hostage of my own self here  
  
With no recollection of my own perseverance  
I am the first to quit  
You been a witness to my own enemy

recentItems.title: GAEREA FEAT. JO QUAIL - Shallow (Acoustic Version) (Official Video)
recentItems.description:
GAEREA FEAT. JO QUAIL - Shallow (Acoustic Version) (Official Video)
Taken from the EP “Shallow” out now. 
Stream/download: https://Gaerea.lnk.to/Shallow-BundleID 
 
Directed by Vammu Creative  
Band Photography by Flávio Almeida 
Behind the Scenes by Soraia Martins & Flávio Almeida 
First Assistant Ricardo Oliveira 
Extras Diogo Silva 
  
Special thanks to  
Câmara Municipal de Santa Maria da Feira  
Festival Imaginárius  
Aisa Music 
 
LYRICS: 
I’m treading in the shallow sea,  
With waves that barely reach my knees,  
Fingers numb, I hold the air,  
In a room that isn’t even there,  
The ceiling’s low, it starts to bend,  
As if it knows how I pretend.  
 
And I keep drowning  
Where the waters of ain won’t let me in,  
And I’m kept barely breathing,  
Hoping someday I’ll just let go.  
 
I’m dancing in the shallow end,  
Where the water’s cold but I still pretend,  
And if I’m sinking just low enough,  
The world might lose me in the rough.  
 
Slipping quiet, fading thin,  
I am offering you my skin  
Just bones wrapped in skin and thread,  
Lost somewhere between life and death.  
I paint a face in the window’s fog,  
It stares right back, the hollow dog,  
Howling with a frozen breath,  
Trapped beneath a layer of death.  
 
And I keep drowning  
Where the waters of ain won’t let me in,  
And I’m kept barely breathing,  
Hoping someday I’ll just let go.
